from google.cloud import language_v1

def moderate_vendor_notes(notes):
    client = language_v1.LanguageServiceClient()
    document = language_v1.Document(content=notes, type_=language_v1.Document.Type.PLAIN_TEXT)
    response = client.analyze_sentiment(request={"document": document})
    if response.document_sentiment.score < -0.2:
        return "Moderated content"
    return notes

from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def translate_invoice_notes(notes, target_language='en'):
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(notes, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

from google.cloud import firestore

def store_expense_record(expense):
    client = firestore.Client()
    expense_ref = client.collection(u'expenses').document()
    expense_ref.set(expense)
    return expense_ref.id
